Unit terms appear in subtitle/keywords; include only if supported unit categories exist (temperature is supported; fluid is not a standard category label).
English unit terms; should be represented with readable unit-conversion copy if site has corresponding coverage.
Local-language unit concepts; website copy needs accurate localized terms.
Abbreviation may mean miles per gallon; confirm it aligns with supported fuel-efficiency units before including.
English unit term; avoid implying regional Spanish copy unless actually localized.
Currency-code tokens are mappable from app catalog; “kilogram” is an English unit term.
English unit term.

Crypto names/codes should be checked against the current catalog. DAI, SUI, CRO, BTC, ETH, ATOM, BNB are catalog-supported; “Cosmos” is an asset name alias, “stablecoin” is a class, and ensure website copy reflects actual rate/conversion availability.

The title concatenates several English tokens. “Silver” is a precious metal term, but “Real” and “Cash” are ambiguous outside context; do not treat the whole title as a single supported-product claim.
“Pound” may mean GBP or a unit of mass. Use context-specific wording when covering it on the website.
“Ounce” can mean a mass unit or be read in precious-metal context; state the intended conversion context.
POL maps to Polygon in the catalog. Treat as the token ticker in this metadata rather than a generic acronym.
Avalanche maps to AVAX in the catalog. The keyword is an asset name, though the local keyword list does not include its ticker.
